input_prompt: Design a base building game with: deep sea construction, pressure management, oxygen systems, creature encounters, resource extraction, research

rules.name: Pressure Management Rule
rules.description: The player must manage the pressure inside the base to prevent damage and maintain a safe environment.

rules.name: Oxygen Management Rule
rules.description: The player must manage the oxygen levels inside the base to prevent suffocation and maintain a safe environment.

rules.name: Resource Extraction Rule
rules.description: The player must extract resources from the ocean floor to sustain their base and progress in the game.

rules.name: Creature Encounter Rule
rules.description: The player may encounter creatures while exploring the ocean floor, which can be beneficial or detrimental to their progress.

rules.name: Research Rule
rules.description: The player can conduct research to improve their base's efficiency, resource extraction, and overall progress.

interactions.result: Player gains access to the ocean floor and can extract resources.
Player extracts a resource from the ocean floor.
Player gains new knowledge and improves their base's efficiency.
Player may gain or lose resources and experience based on the creature's behavior.

transitions.trigger: Player defeats or escapes the creature
